_comment: Hierarchical LIF — lif_step_partitioned with NEURONS_PER_THREAD=4 on 10K neurons, single timestep. dispatch = ceil(10000/(256*4)) = 10. WARNING: the WGSL module declares TWO entry points (lif_step_partitioned and synaptic_current_shared_tiled) and BOTH reuse @group(0) @binding(0..3) for distinct uniform/storage types (LIFParams vs SynapticParams, membrane_v vs weights, etc.). WGSL allows duplicate binding decls only when each entry point statically uses a disjoint subset. With layout:'auto' the BGL is derived from the statically-used bindings of the SELECTED entry point, so only the 5 bindings consumed by lif_step_partitioned (lif_params, membrane_v, synaptic_input, spikes, refractory) are bound. If pipeline creation rejects the module due to declaration conflicts, the shader needs to be split into two files before bench-capture can target it.
section: §5.4 hierarchical workgroup decomposition — 10K LIF neurons via per-thread partitioning (4 neurons per thread). Baseline counterpart lives in paper-2-lif-step-10k.json (lif-neuron.wgsl, NEURONS_PER_THREAD=1, dispatch=40).
